Allocates and copies the selected bytes, publishes buffer/encoded length and marks the source flag. Returns lookup/allocation/copy status. Caller owns the returned allocation; built-in entries are copied rather than returned directly.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ResolveVitmPayload
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_ResolveVitmPayload(uint * encoded_bytes, byte * source_flag, void * sidv_or_sidl, byte * * output, uint encoded_id)

additionalProperties.comment:
Transferred from 2.0.4; absolute addresses below refer to that version.
Validates request/context and encoded context flags. Uses request bytes at +0x10, preserves clear prefix/gaps/tail when copying out of place, and batches 16-byte encrypted regions through context-owned scratch buffers. Unwraps context key/IV material into temporaries and optionally updates chaining state for streaming mode. Calls 0835e1f4, whose hardware request is fixed at 4096 bytes; only selected plaintext regions are copied back. Returns status; exact flag meanings and all malformed-length behavior remain unresolved.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_DecryptSampleBlocks

additionalProperties.comment: Returns 0 for numerically zero value, otherwise -1 or +1 from the decoded signed limb count. The zero test scans limbs, so a noncanonical nonzero count with all-zero limbs still returns 0.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_BigIntSign

additionalProperties.comment: Requires payload_bytes >=0x14 and nonnull output. Allocates payload_bytes+12 backing bytes plus a 12-byte descriptor, zeroes the prefix, stores encoded total length and flags=0. Releases backing if descriptor allocation fails. Returns zero on success or an argument/allocation status.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_AllocateRecordBuffer

additionalProperties.comment: Creates a 0x28-byte sidd object with an empty record descriptor and initial scalar child. Stores decoded version/mode fields, copies the 24-byte identity and publishes output on success. Frees partial descriptor/object on failure. Version and mode validation use encoded arguments.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_CreateEmptySiddObject
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_CreateEmptySiddObject(byte * identity24, uint encoded_version, uint encoded_mode, void * * output)

additionalProperties.comment: Creates a 0x24-byte sidv/sidl object with descriptor at +0x20, decoded version/mode fields and optional 24-byte identity. Creates an empty root record and publishes output only on success; cleans up on failure. Validates version/mode and output.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_CreateEmptySidvOrSidlObject
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_CreateEmptySidvOrSidlObject(byte * identity24, void * * output, uint encoded_version, uint encoded_mode)

additionalProperties.comment: Finalizes the software digest, first transferring accelerated SHA-1 state back when needed. Adds encoded 0x80 padding and 64-bit bit length (MD5 little-endian, SHA-1 big-endian), writes digest_bytes in internal byte encoding, and overwrites state bytes 0..0x5f. Output must hold 16 or 20 bytes; preserves size/mode fields for outer HMAC finalization.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_DigestFinalEncoded

additionalProperties.comment: Copies encoded signed count and abs(decoded count) limbs, high to low. Exact self-copy is a no-op. Destination capacity is supplied by caller; no allocation or capacity check occurs.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_BigIntCopy

additionalProperties.comment: Null-safe cleanup of storage-record +0x68 (sidb). Releases the descriptor at +0, overwrites and frees each nonnull 0x200-byte buffer at +0x28/+0x2c, then overwrites and frees the 0x34-byte object. Returns zero.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_DestroySidbObject

additionalProperties.comment: Rejects borrowed/read-only backing flags, inserts a child header and copies bytes into its payload with byte encoding x*0xa7. Copy direction follows source/destination order. Optionally returns the new offset; returns insertion/descriptor status. Source must remain valid across possible backing resize.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_InsertRecordPlainPayload
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_InsertRecordPlainPayload(uint key_b, uint bytes, uint parent_offset, OSOS_FairPlayBufferDescriptor * descriptor, uint key_a, uint ordinal, byte * input, uint * record_offset)

additionalProperties.comment: Null-safe cleanup of storage-record +0x6c (sidr). Releases the descriptor at +0, clears that pointer, overwrites the 0x34-byte object, and frees it. Returns zero; the apparent second return register in the old decompile is incidental.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_DestroySidrObject

additionalProperties.comment: Imports up to 256 ordinary big-endian bytes into encoded little-endian 32-bit limbs, then normalizes leading zero limbs and stores encoded count. Returns zero or length error. Input/output pointers and output capacity are caller responsibilities.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_BigIntImportPlain
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_BigIntImportPlain(byte * input, uint * output, uint bytes)

additionalProperties.comment:
Transferred from 2.0.4; absolute addresses below refer to that version.
Serializes the parsed sidr object through 0x083339e0 using its backing descriptor, encoded size/flags and header at +4. Returns status; successful callers write the allocated output buffer to sidr and free it. Rejects a null object.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_SerializeSidrObject
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_SerializeSidrObject(void * object, uint * output_bytes, byte * * output_buffer)

additionalProperties.comment: Scans down past zero high limbs and finds the highest set bit of the decoded magnitude. Returns 0 for zero, otherwise significant-bit count. Does not modify or normalize the stored representation.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_BigIntBitLength

additionalProperties.comment: Rejects null descriptor or an already-set decoded flag bit 0. Sets that bit, optionally publishes backing pointer and decoded length, and returns zero. The view aliases descriptor storage; this flag is a mutation/borrowing guard, not a synchronization primitive.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_AcquireRecordBufferView
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_AcquireRecordBufferView(OSOS_FairPlayBufferDescriptor * descriptor, uint * bytes, byte * * data)

additionalProperties.comment: Computes the Montgomery product of encoded magnitudes using mont->negative_inverse, then reduces below modulus and copies into output. A zero operand produces zero. Uses fixed stack workspaces and data-dependent loops; caller must provide supported sizes and initialized Montgomery state.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_BigIntMontgomeryMultiply
additionalProperties.value: void FairPlay_BigIntMontgomeryMultiply(uint * output, OSOS_FairPlayMontgomery * mont, uint * left, uint * right, uint * modulus)

additionalProperties.comment: Clears decoded flag bit 0 and re-encodes flags. Returns zero for nonnull descriptor, otherwise invalid-argument status. Does not free storage or invalidate an external pointer previously returned by AcquireRecordBufferView.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ReleaseRecordBufferView

additionalProperties.comment: Converts the encoded scalar into a four-byte big-endian payload, decodes key/parent argument words and inserts it through InsertRecordEncodedPayload. ordinal is passed through; optional record_offset receives the new child. Returns argument or insertion status.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_InsertEncodedScalarRecord
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_InsertEncodedScalarRecord(uint encoded_key_a, uint ordinal, OSOS_FairPlayBufferDescriptor * descriptor, uint encoded_key_b, uint encoded_value, uint encoded_parent, uint * record_offset)

additionalProperties.comment: Consumes plain bytes with count-first calling convention. Software mode encodes bytes into 64-byte compression blocks and advances byte count; accelerated SHA-1 mode completes a partial software block before switching, then fills/flushes 4096-byte backend staging. Returns zero or backend error. Caller supplies a valid digest/input contract.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_DigestUpdatePlainCountFirst
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_DigestUpdatePlainCountFirst(uint bytes, byte * input, OSOS_FairPlayDigest * digest)

additionalProperties.comment:
Transferred from 2.0.4; absolute addresses below refer to that version.
Returns ordinary digest bytes. Active SHA-1 backend finalizes through 0x082bba44 and clears backend pointer on success; software path finalizes to a temporary encoded digest then decodes it. Copies digest_bytes only on success. Rejects null output; returns status.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_DigestFinalPlain

additionalProperties.comment: Imports encoded_input when present, otherwise plain_input; exponent NULL selects 65537. Performs modular exponentiation and exports bytes to output_e9 when supplied, otherwise output_b7, using their respective byte encodings. Writes modulus byte width multiplied by 0xc8670a7f to encoded_result_bytes. Returns zero or argument error; caller must supply a nonnull length output and valid buffers/modulus.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ModExpEncodedBuffers
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_ModExpEncodedBuffers(uint bytes, byte * output_b7, byte * plain_input, uint * modulus, uint * exponent, byte * output_e9, byte * encoded_input, uint * encoded_result_bytes)

additionalProperties.comment:
Transferred from 2.0.4; absolute addresses below refer to that version.
Builds an encoded SHA-1 digest over fixed 13-byte prefix, user/right IDs, two input spans and fixed 11-byte suffix. Transforms the middle 16 digest bytes through 08336368 and copies the resulting 20 bytes to output in its required encoding. Returns mapped transform status. Caller supplies valid spans/output; this is a format-specific derivation, not plain SHA-1.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_DeriveRightsDigest20
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_DeriveRightsDigest20(uint encoded_first_bytes, uint encoded_rights_id, byte * output20, byte * encoded_first_input, byte * encoded_second_input, uint encoded_user_id, uint encoded_second_bytes)

additionalProperties.comment: Enumerates root vitm records from the descriptor at object+0x20 into a caller-provided 20-word array. Applies ID-prefix selection/reordering and clears unused slots. Writes count, returns argument/count/lookup status and does not allocate. The prefix policy is not fully resolved; IDs must retain their internal representation.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_CollectVitmIds
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_CollectVitmIds(uint * ids20, void * sidv_or_sidl, uint * count)

additionalProperties.comment: Walks the schi region recorded in sinf_info. Reads user/key IDs, 16-byte iviv offset, righ/name/priv offsets and lengths, and recognizes free; sets found bits in sinf_info. Enforces relevant atom sizes and exact region end. Requires flags 0x3e0 normally or 0x320 in reduced mode. Offsets refer to the supplied sinf base; caller provides fields. Returns zero or parse error.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ParseSchiChildren
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_ParseSchiChildren(OSOS_FairPlaySinfInfo * sinf_info, byte * sinf, OSOS_FairPlaySchiInfo * fields, int reduced_requirements)

additionalProperties.comment: Writes byte 0xff to persistent record 0 offset 0x14, replacing the sidr digest marker. Returns mapped storage status. This function takes no path argument despite stale caller decompiles carrying one.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_InvalidateSidrDigestMarker

additionalProperties.comment: Null-safe destructor for the 0x11c-byte verification object. Wipes/frees owned buffers at +0x14 and +0x100 using their encoded sizes at +0x18/+0x104, then wipes and frees the object. Does not release unrelated external pointers.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_DestroyVerificationObject

additionalProperties.comment: From the decoded group offset, finds head/keyB=1 then guid/keyB=1 and copies the leaf payload as plain bytes with capacity 20. Returns status and the copy helper's encoded length; requires nonnull descriptor, output and length pointers.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_CopyGroupGuid
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_CopyGroupGuid(byte * output20, OSOS_FairPlayBufferDescriptor * descriptor, uint encoded_group_offset, uint * encoded_bytes)

additionalProperties.comment: Exports magnitude as fixed-width big-endian bytes multiplied by 0xb7, padding leading bytes with zero. Requires output capacity at least the stored limb count times four; insufficient width silently leaves output unchanged.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_BigIntExportB7
additionalProperties.value: void FairPlay_BigIntExportB7(uint * value, byte * output, uint output_bytes)

additionalProperties.comment: Reads one ASN.1 tag/length/value from cursor. Accepts single-octet tags and definite short or 1..4-byte long lengths; rejects high-tag-number and indefinite length forms. On success advances cursor past content and returns tag, content pointer and length without copying. Bounds checks use 32-bit additions; returns zero or parse error.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ReadASN1Element
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_ReadASN1Element(byte * input, uint input_bytes, uint * content_bytes, byte * * content, uint * cursor, uint * tag)

additionalProperties.comment: Transfers SHA-1 state between encoded software storage and an aligned backend when requested mode differs from flag 0x200. Converts the partial block and five state words, moves byte counters, and updates backend pointer/flag only on successful transfer. Overwrites temporary block storage before return. Returns transfer status; callers gate further hashing on zero.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_DigestSwitchBackend

additionalProperties.comment: Reads the sidr file into allocated storage, computes an identity-dependent keyed digest, and compares it with the 21-byte persistent record read at record 0 offset 0. Publishes buffer and length only on success; failure paths release the temporary file buffer. Returns status. Identity is a length-prefixed byte sequence.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ReadSidrAndCheckDigest
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_ReadSidrAndCheckDigest(uint * output_bytes, void * path, void * identity, byte * * output_buffer)

additionalProperties.comment: Finds root child vers/keyB=1 and reads its encoded 32-bit payload. Optionally writes two separately encoded fields derived from the upper/lower 16-bit portions. Returns status; NULL output pointers skip their respective writes. Output words are not plain version numbers.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ReadRootVersionFields
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_ReadRootVersionFields(OSOS_FairPlayBufferDescriptor * descriptor, uint * encoded_upper_field, uint * encoded_lower_field)

additionalProperties.comment: For nonzero length, writes sidr then computes an identity-dependent keyed digest and stores 20 digest bytes plus a zero marker in persistent record 0. Zero length uses FairPlay_DeleteStorageFile instead. Callers do not consume a return value; internal write failures select cleanup/exit paths.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_WriteSidrAndDigest
additionalProperties.value: void FairPlay_WriteSidrAndDigest(uint bytes, void * identity, byte * buffer, void * path)

additionalProperties.comment: Reserves a new 20-byte header plus payload beneath the validated parent. key_b=0 chooses the first unused positive ID for key_a; ordinal=0 appends, otherwise inserts at the requested one-based position. Resizes/moves backing storage, writes encoded length/keys with zero child count and increments the parent child count. Writes new offset on success; returns status.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_InsertRecordHeader
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_InsertRecordHeader(OSOS_FairPlayBufferDescriptor * descriptor, uint key_b, uint key_a, uint * record_offset, uint ordinal, uint payload_bytes, uint parent_offset)

additionalProperties.comment: Decodes signed limb count, scans its absolute number of encoded 32-bit limbs, and returns true only when every limb is zero. Does not normalize the stored count or modify value.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_BigIntIsZero

additionalProperties.comment: Uses absolute bit_index, returns zero beyond the stored limb count, otherwise decodes the selected 32-bit limb and returns its requested bit as 0/1. Magnitude operation ignores the sign of value.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_BigIntTestBit

additionalProperties.comment: Releases the owned buffer descriptor at +0x20, overwrites the 0x24-byte object, then frees it. Used for storage-record sidv (+0x60) and sidl (+0x70) objects. Null input takes a separate status path; no owned object is freed in that case.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_DestroySidvOrSidlObject

additionalProperties.comment: Squares an encoded magnitude in the Montgomery domain, reduces below modulus and writes output; zero input writes zero. Uses mont->negative_inverse and fixed stack workspaces. Caller supplies initialized state and supported operand sizes.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_BigIntMontgomerySquare
additionalProperties.value: void FairPlay_BigIntMontgomerySquare(uint * modulus, uint * output, OSOS_FairPlayMontgomery * mont, uint * value)

additionalProperties.comment: Tests the decoded selector against 3 through 8. Returns 0x93 for a match and zero otherwise, so this is an encoded truth result rather than a C bool. Does not modify state.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_IsSelector3Through8

additionalProperties.comment: Refreshes parsed FairPlay storage state according to an obfuscated selector. Checks/loads IC-Info paths at +0xa0..0xb0 and creates/replaces parsed objects at +0x60..0x70 using identity at +0x28. Error/recovery branches release parsed objects, invalidate persisted files and reset state flags; temporary file buffers are freed. Returns status. This is mutating, allocation- and disk-I/O-capable work, not a pure handle lookup; selector meanings remain unresolved.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_RefreshStorageRecord

additionalProperties.comment:
Transferred from 2.0.4; absolute addresses below refer to that version.
Selects a matching or available record in registry 089cb020, stride 0xb8, for storage-context construction. Reads stored path pointer +8 and reference count +0xc, compares path bytes through obfuscated normalization, and returns a candidate pointer or null. No allocation or reference-count write occurs here; constructor claims/initializes the returned record. Exact path normalization is unresolved.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_FindStorageRecordForPath

additionalProperties.comment: Serializes a plain 32-bit value most-significant byte first, applies the digest byte encoding x*0x9d-0x14 and appends four bytes through DigestUpdateEncoded. Intended as a scalar-prefix helper; callers ignore the propagated register status.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_DigestUpdateU32BE

additionalProperties.comment: Requires sidr version 0x10000, resolves user/rtal and reads rori/rwri payloads into 2048/256-byte stack buffers. Rewrites the encoded scalar at rwri+4, recalculates the trailing 20-byte rights digest at +0xec, replaces rwri and sets the dirty byte at sidr+0x21 on success. Returns lookup/copy/digest/update status.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_UpdateSidrRightsField
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_UpdateSidrRightsField(uint encoded_rights_id, uint encoded_user_id, void * sidr, uint encoded_value)

additionalProperties.comment: Enumerates root grup children, reads each head/guid payload into a 20-byte stack buffer and compares against the supplied identifier. Writes the matched encoded group offset and associated keyB; returns match/argument/read status. Length and offset values use internal encodings. Does not allocate or modify records.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_FindGroupByGuid
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_FindGroupByGuid(uint * encoded_group_offset, byte * guid, uint * group_key_b, OSOS_FairPlayBufferDescriptor * descriptor, uint encoded_guid_bytes)

additionalProperties.comment: Creates a 32-byte encoded root record in a new descriptor. Zeroes backing, writes root length 20 at offset 12 and the two big-endian key words at offsets 16/20 using multiply-by-0xa7 byte encoding. Stores encoded total length and zero flags; publishes output on success.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_CreateEmptyRecordBuffer
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_CreateEmptyRecordBuffer(uint key_a, uint key_b, OSOS_FairPlayBufferDescriptor * * output)

additionalProperties.comment: Requires descriptor/data/output, validates the record and rejects nonzero decoded child count. Bounds-checks payload_offset+4 against payload length, decodes a big-endian 32-bit payload word and writes it to output. Returns zero or a descriptor/record/type/bounds status.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ReadRecordU32
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_ReadRecordU32(uint * output, uint offset, uint payload_offset, OSOS_FairPlayBufferDescriptor * descriptor)

additionalProperties.comment: Feeds internally encoded bytes, buffers partial 64-byte blocks and updates byte count. Completes full blocks through DigestCompressEncodedBlock. For accelerated SHA-1, first transfers backend state to software; returns that transfer error or zero. Input bytes use the internal encoding, unlike DigestUpdatePlain.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_DigestUpdateEncoded
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_DigestUpdateEncoded(byte * encoded_input, OSOS_FairPlayDigest * state, uint bytes)

additionalProperties.comment: Validates record offset and optionally returns (decoded record length-20) multiplied by 0xbd7d7cff. Output is intentionally encoded rather than a plain byte count. Returns zero on success or invalid descriptor/record status.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_GetRecordPayloadLength
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_GetRecordPayloadLength(uint offset, uint * encoded_bytes, OSOS_FairPlayBufferDescriptor * descriptor)

additionalProperties.comment: Finalizes inner hash into a 20-byte temporary buffer, reinitializes the same digest mode, feeds stored outer pad plus encoded inner digest, then emits ordinary output bytes. sidr callers receive a 20-byte SHA-1 HMAC. This wrapper ignores helper status values.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_HmacFinalPlain

additionalProperties.comment: Updates value = value - subtrahend using encoded signed limb counts and encoded 32-bit magnitudes. Handles zero and opposite signs, propagates carry/borrow, flips sign if needed and removes leading zero limbs. Destination capacity is supplied by caller.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_BigIntSubtract

additionalProperties.comment: Validates the encoded record tree using an allocated max_depth * 12 traversal stack. Checks minimum headers, record ends, child counts, exact subtree boundaries and depth limit. Root begins at backing offset 12. Frees the stack and returns zero or argument/allocation/layout/depth error; does not modify the record tree.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ValidateRecordTree

additionalProperties.comment: Same scalar-record and four-byte bounds checks as ReadRecordU32, then multiplies decoded payload word by 0x95fcd51f before publishing it. Returns status; output is not a plain integer.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ReadRecordEncodedU32
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_ReadRecordEncodedU32(uint offset, uint * encoded_output, OSOS_FairPlayBufferDescriptor * descriptor, uint payload_offset)

additionalProperties.comment:
Transferred from 2.0.4; absolute addresses below refer to that version.
Looks up a three-key entry in a lazily allocated 512-byte cache at context+0x2c (16 entries of 32 bytes). Returns the 16-byte payload at entry+0x10 on a hit. On a miss chooses an entry using age metadata, fills it through 082f1be0, stores keys/age and advances context+0x30. Caller supplies a valid context; returns NULL on allocation/builder failure. Returned storage belongs to context and may be replaced by later lookups.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_GetVerificationCacheEntry
additionalProperties.value: byte * FairPlay_GetVerificationCacheEntry(uint encoded_key_a, uint encoded_key_b, void * context, void * builder_input, uint encoded_key_c)

additionalProperties.comment: Shifts encoded integer magnitude right in place by whole limbs and remaining bits, preserving sign and normalizing encoded count. Shifting past its length writes zero. Does not clear unused trailing storage. Shared tail target of BigIntShift.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_BigIntShiftRight

additionalProperties.comment: If sidr has no cached selection at +0x28, collects vitm IDs and stores two selected IDs at +0x28/+0x24. Extracts the selected vitm body, passes it with user/rights IDs to ProcessRightsRecord and frees the temporary body. Returns selection/extraction/processing status. Requires a valid sidv/sidl source.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ApplySidrRightsFromSidv
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_ApplySidrRightsFromSidv(void * sidr, uint encoded_rights_id, void * operation_context, void * sidv_or_sidl, uint encoded_user_id)

additionalProperties.comment: Imports up to 256 big-endian bytes after internal digest decoding byte*0xb5-0xdc. Encodes limbs/count and normalizes high zero limbs. Returns zero or length error; the input encoding differs from ordinary bytes accepted by BigIntImportPlain.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_BigIntImportDigestEncoding
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_BigIntImportDigestEncoding(byte * encoded_input, uint bytes, uint * output)

additionalProperties.comment: XORs each byte with 0xc6 in place for signed positive length. Used around the obfuscated transform wrappers. Applying the same operation twice restores the input; there is no local pointer or capacity validation.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_XorTransformBufferC6

additionalProperties.comment: Decodes the input record backing, validates tree depth <=6, checks root keys and vers fields, and performs an optional time-related record check. On success allocates a 0x34-byte sidr object owning the descriptor, copies identity24 and initializes dirty/cache fields. Destroys temporary backing on failure. Returns an internally mapped status; detailed policy constants remain encoded.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ParseSidrObject
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_ParseSidrObject(uint encoded_mode, byte * identity24, void * * output, uint encoded_bytes, byte * input)

additionalProperties.comment: Requires a nonzero record offset with exactly four payload bytes. Reads its big-endian scalar through ReadRecordU32 and writes an affine-encoded output, rather than a plain integer. Returns the record/argument status; output is written only after successful length and read checks.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ReadRecordAffineScalar
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_ReadRecordAffineScalar(uint * encoded_value, OSOS_FairPlayBufferDescriptor * descriptor, uint record_offset)

additionalProperties.comment: Shifts the encoded sign/magnitude integer in place: positive bits shift left, zero/negative bits shift right by the negated amount. Preserves sign and normalizes limb count; an excessive right shift produces zero. Caller supplies capacity. Tail-branches into shared shift implementations; callers ignore the incidental register result.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_BigIntShift

additionalProperties.comment: Finds a child using decoded parent/key arguments, then copies its leaf payload through CopyRecordPayloadEncoded with larger capacity allowed. Reads capacity from the encoded in/out word, which is replaced by encoded payload length on success. Returns argument, missing-child or copy status.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_FindChildAndCopyEncoded
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_FindChildAndCopyEncoded(byte * output, uint encoded_parent, OSOS_FairPlayBufferDescriptor * descriptor, uint * encoded_capacity_and_bytes, uint encoded_key_a, uint key_b)

additionalProperties.comment: Null-safe cleanup of storage-record +0x64 (sidd). Releases the descriptor at +0, clears that pointer, overwrites the 0x28-byte object, and frees it. Returns zero.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_DestroySiddObject

additionalProperties.comment:
Transferred from 2.0.4; absolute addresses below refer to that version.
Null context returns 0. Otherwise calls FairPlay_DestroyDecryptionContext and returns its 32-bit status; the obfuscation multipliers reduce to identity modulo 2^32. Used in failed context creation and through game cleanup wrapper 0804bb90. Does not release a storage-registry handle.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ReleaseDecryptionContext

additionalProperties.comment: Validates the record and optionally publishes its two header keys at +4/+8 after byte decoding plus separate affine word encodings. Returns status. The output words are encoded and must not be compared directly with plain key constants.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_GetRecordEncodedKeys
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_GetRecordEncodedKeys(uint * encoded_key_b, OSOS_FairPlayBufferDescriptor * descriptor, uint * encoded_key_a, uint offset)

additionalProperties.comment: Initializes caller-provided one and r_squared buffers to R mod modulus and R^2 mod modulus, and stores the negative inverse of the low modulus word. R is 2^(32 * modulus limb count). Assumes a valid odd nonzero modulus; does not allocate or validate buffer capacity.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_BigIntMontgomeryInit

additionalProperties.comment: Requires mutable unborrowed backing and a leaf record. Resizes the record if needed, then replaces its payload using (x*0xb5+0x24)*0xa7 byte conversion. Returns validation/resize status; caller keeps input valid across reallocation and supplies bytes of source.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ReplaceRecordEncodedPayload
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_ReplaceRecordEncodedPayload(byte * encoded_input, OSOS_FairPlayBufferDescriptor * descriptor, uint bytes, uint record_offset)

additionalProperties.comment: Writes an encoded sign/count and encoded magnitude limbs for the signed input. Zero sets count to zero. Caller supplies output capacity; previously stored high limbs beyond the new count remain untouched.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_BigIntSetInt

additionalProperties.comment: Decodes key/parent argument words, finds the matching child and reads its four-byte payload through ReadRecordAffineScalar. Returns an error if required pointers/keys are invalid or the child/read fails. Output remains in the scalar helper's affine encoding.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_FindChildAndReadScalar
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_FindChildAndReadScalar(OSOS_FairPlayBufferDescriptor * descriptor, uint encoded_key_b, uint * encoded_value, uint encoded_key_a, uint encoded_parent)

additionalProperties.comment: Feeds ordinary input bytes, encoding them for the software 64-byte block path. SHA-1 with flag 0x100 can switch to a backend that stages 0x1000-byte chunks. Returns zero on success or backend error; null input returns bytes and zero length returns zero. May change backend ownership and state flags.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_DigestUpdatePlain
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_DigestUpdatePlain(byte * input, uint bytes, OSOS_FairPlayDigest * state)

additionalProperties.comment:
Transferred from 2.0.4; absolute addresses below refer to that version.
Searches registry at 089cb020 with record stride 0xb8 for an encoded handle match. Routes the selected record through FairPlay_RefreshStorageRecord with a transformed refresh_selector; returns the record pointer or null on lookup/refresh failure. This lookup can perform disk I/O through refresh. Selector encoding and complete handle-validation rules remain unresolved.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ResolveStorageHandle

additionalProperties.comment: Sets context tag at +0, clears scratch pointer +4 and allocates AES scratch there. On scratch failure destroys the whole context through FairPlay_DestroyDecryptionContext. Returns mapped allocation status; callers must not reuse context after failure.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_AttachContextAESScratch

additionalProperties.comment: Rejects borrowed/read-only backing flags, inserts a child and converts input bytes into record encoding with x*0x8b. Copy direction follows source/destination order. Optionally writes new record offset and returns status. Caller must keep source valid across possible backing resize.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_InsertRecordEncodedPayload
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_InsertRecordEncodedPayload(uint bytes, uint parent_offset, byte * encoded_input, uint key_a, uint ordinal, OSOS_FairPlayBufferDescriptor * descriptor, uint * record_offset, uint key_b)

additionalProperties.comment: Returns one when selector is 0, 1 or 2, otherwise zero. The two internal multipliers cancel modulo 2^32, so the external selector is plain. Pure predicate; no memory writes.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_IsSmallSelector

additionalProperties.comment: Uses the record descriptor at object+0 to find root divi/keyB=1. Reads its first big-endian payload word; a missing divi writes zero. Requires object and output, returns status, and does not create the optional record.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ReadOptionalDivi

additionalProperties.comment: Validates a scalar record, decodes payload bytes with multiplier 0x17 and copies in overlap-aware direction. Requires payload length <=capacity, or exact length when allow_larger_capacity=0. Optionally publishes an encoded copied-length word. Returns status; a zero capacity permits null output only for an empty payload.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_CopyRecordPayloadPlain
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_CopyRecordPayloadPlain(uint offset, OSOS_FairPlayBufferDescriptor * descriptor, uint * encoded_bytes, byte * output, uint capacity, int allow_larger_capacity)

additionalProperties.comment: Validates a leaf record and copies its payload using x*0x1b-0x14 byte encoding. Requires payload <= capacity, or exact equality when allow_larger_capacity=0. Optional encoded_bytes receives payload size * 0xbd7d7cff. Returns zero or descriptor/record/size error; supports either copy direction.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_CopyRecordPayloadEncoded
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_CopyRecordPayloadEncoded(uint * encoded_bytes, uint capacity, OSOS_FairPlayBufferDescriptor * descriptor, int allow_larger_capacity, byte * output, uint record_offset)

additionalProperties.comment: Exports magnitude as fixed-width big-endian bytes multiplied by 0xe9, with leading zero padding. Returns without writing if output_bytes is smaller than abs(decoded limb count)*4. Ignores sign and does not return a status.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_BigIntExportE9
additionalProperties.value: void FairPlay_BigIntExportE9(uint output_bytes, byte * output, uint * value)

additionalProperties.comment: Validates an encoded record and returns its offset, or zero on failure. Offset zero means root at 12. Decodes big-endian size (minimum 20), checks end bounds/overflow and, when child count at +14 is nonzero, walks exactly that many nested records and requires their lengths to fill the parent. Internal bytes decode by multiplication by 0x17.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ValidateRecordOffset

additionalProperties.comment: Tests the decoded type against 50, 51, 60, 61, 70 and 80; returns plain 0/1. Used by verification-object construction/processing. Pure predicate; the higher-level meanings of these numeric types remain unresolved.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_IsVerificationType

additionalProperties.comment: Walks ordinary big-endian child atoms starting at sinf+8, checking minimum size and end bounds. Captures frma as a native format word, sign/schi payload offsets and sizes, and three skcr words; marks schm presence. Success requires exact end and flags frma|schm|schi (0x0b). Caller initializes info; duplicate recognized atoms overwrite prior fields.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ParseSinfChildren
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_ParseSinfChildren(byte * sinf, uint bytes, OSOS_FairPlaySinfInfo * info)

additionalProperties.comment: Initializes SHA-1 mode, digests two decoded 32-bit prefixes in first-prefix then second-prefix order, then the encoded input payload and finalizes to a 20-byte encoded digest. Checks input/output pointers. Returns zero on the completed path; intermediate digest statuses are not checked.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_DigestPrefixedPayload
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_DigestPrefixedPayload(uint encoded_second_prefix, byte * encoded_digest20, uint encoded_first_prefix, uint encoded_bytes, byte * encoded_input)

additionalProperties.comment:
Transferred from 2.0.4; absolute addresses below refer to that version.
Checks an encoded context tag, releases nonnull scratch object at +4 through 082a7398, overwrites the 0x50-byte context through an obfuscated byte loop, then frees it with 08023ef0. Returns a 32-bit status; exact tag/error encoding is unresolved. Outer release wrapper handles null. Overwrite bytes are generated values rather than a simple zero-fill.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_DestroyDecryptionContext

additionalProperties.comment: Rejects null descriptor or null backing pointer. If bit 1 of (flags_at_8 * 3) is clear, overwrites the decoded byte count from +4 and frees backing storage at +0. Then overwrites and frees the 12-byte descriptor. Returns zero on cleanup; ownership flags and length are encoded.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_DestroyBufferDescriptor

additionalProperties.comment: Allocates an owned record buffer and converts input bytes with ((byte*0x49)-1)*0xa7. includes_prefix selects a full-buffer copy versus adding a zero 12-byte prefix. Rejects null input and short prefixed data, propagates allocation errors, and publishes the descriptor on success. Caller supplies a valid output pointer.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ImportRecordBuffer
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_ImportRecordBuffer(OSOS_FairPlayBufferDescriptor * * output, uint input_bytes, int includes_prefix, byte * input)

additionalProperties.comment: Walks ASN.1 elements against 28-byte encoded rules, with a fixed 16-level traversal stack. Supports optional rules, child/next indices, expected-payload comparison and callbacks receiving a 20-byte OSOS_FairPlayASN1Match. Special tag -0x1000000 accepts several ASN.1 string tags. Returns parse/callback status; callbacks may mutate their context. Does not allocate.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ParseASN1Rules
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_ParseASN1Rules(OSOS_FairPlayASN1Rule * rules, int repeat_mode, void * callback_context, uint bytes, int rule_count, byte * input)

additionalProperties.comment:
Transferred from 2.0.4; absolute addresses below refer to that version.
Allocates a 0x24-byte sidv/sidl object, decodes its backing through 08303c98, then validates the record tree with maximum depth 3. Copies the 24-byte identity and decoded mode into the object on success. On failure destroys the descriptor, wipes/frees the object and returns status.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ParseSidvOrSidlObject
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_ParseSidvOrSidlObject(uint encoded_bytes, byte * input, byte * identity24, void * * output, uint encoded_mode)

additionalProperties.comment: Validates parent and walks nested records in its payload, comparing decoded header key A/B. Returns matching child offset or zero; optional ordinal is one-based. Traversal relies on the parent validation and encoded record lengths.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_FindChildRecord
additionalProperties.value: uint FairPlay_FindChildRecord(OSOS_FairPlayBufferDescriptor * descriptor, uint key_b, uint parent_offset, ushort * ordinal, uint key_a)

additionalProperties.comment: Computes base^exponent mod modulus for encoded integers. Converts base into Montgomery form, scans exponent bits from most to least significant with square/conditional multiply, converts out and copies to output. Uses two fixed 524-byte stack workspaces; caller initializes mont and supplies valid sizes.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_BigIntModExp
additionalProperties.value: void FairPlay_BigIntModExp(OSOS_FairPlayMontgomery * mont, uint * modulus, uint * base, uint * exponent, uint * output)

additionalProperties.comment: Initializes HMAC with an internally encoded key. Keys longer than 64 bytes are hashed first; prepares encoded inner/outer pads using XOR 0x36/0x5c, stores outer pad at +0x68 and feeds the 64-byte inner pad. Null or zero-length key returns without initializing state. sidr callers use a 24-byte encoded key and mode 2 (SHA-1).
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_HmacInitEncodedKey
additionalProperties.value: void FairPlay_HmacInitEncodedKey(uint key_bytes, OSOS_FairPlayHmac * state, byte * encoded_key, uint mode_flags)

additionalProperties.comment: Shifts encoded integer magnitude left in place by whole limbs and remaining bits, preserving sign, filling low limbs with zero and updating encoded count. Caller supplies enough capacity. Shared tail target of BigIntShift; argument order is bits then value.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_BigIntShiftLeft

additionalProperties.comment: Validates the user-ID argument and requires sidr version at +0x2c to equal 0x10000, then dispatches to ApplySidrRightsFromSidv with decoded/re-encoded scalar arguments. Returns mapped argument/version/processing status. Caller provides a valid sidr pointer.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ApplySidrRightsV1
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_ApplySidrRightsV1(void * sidv_or_sidl, uint encoded_rights_id, void * operation_context, void * sidr, uint encoded_user_id)

additionalProperties.comment: Writes 0 to WDTCON (0x3c800000), then 0x0aa5 to SWRCON (0x3c500050) to request a software reset. Spins forever if reset has not yet occurred.
additionalProperties.name: ResetSocAndWait

additionalProperties.comment:
Transferred from 2.0.4; absolute addresses below refer to that version.
Calls locked hardware AES using input=scratch+4 pointer, output=scratch+8 pointer, supplied key/IV, selector 0 and a fixed length of 0x1000 bytes. Returns 0 on hardware status 0, otherwise 0xffff5b32. Caller 0831bf88 also places a byte count on the stack, but this wrapper never reads it; both scratch buffers must hold a full page.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ProcessAESScratchPage
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_ProcessAESScratchPage(void * scratch, uint direction, byte * key, byte * iv)

additionalProperties.comment: Copies bytes sequentially to state+0 when both pointers are nonnull; returns zero after copying or 9 for a null pointer. Used by SHA feed for 0..63 trailing bytes. No local length/capacity check; caller must supply a nonnegative count fitting the partial block.
additionalProperties.name: Crypto_SHA1StorePartialBlock
additionalProperties.value: int Crypto_SHA1StorePartialBlock(OSOS_SHA1BackendState * state, byte * input, int bytes)

additionalProperties.comment: Returns the cached pointer to the imported 0x120-byte SysInfo at 0x08a1a330; initializes the pointer on first use.
additionalProperties.name: Platform_GetImportedSysInfo

additionalProperties.comment: Reads the boot-info record at offset 0x18. Requires SysI magic, then copies 0x120 bytes from its pointer into 0x08a1a330. Returns 0 on success or 0x52 for invalid magic.
additionalProperties.name: Platform_ImportBootSysInfo

additionalProperties.comment: Configures timer E with ECLK input, prescaler 11, maximum reload, and clear/enable command. At the Classic 12 MHz ECLK this produces the 1 MHz counter read by Platform_ReadFrameClock.
additionalProperties.name: Platform_InitMicrosecondCounter

additionalProperties.comment: Queries the prior resource-gate state for mask (0,1), enables that resource and clears control at MMIO 0x3c100000. Returns the previous gate-state token for RestoreHardware. Does not itself read a random word or acquire a mutex.
additionalProperties.name: CryptoRandom_PrepareHardware

additionalProperties.comment: Polls MMIO 0x3c100000 until status bits 0..2 are nonzero, then returns the word at +4. Assumes hardware has been prepared. Has no timeout, error return or allocation.
additionalProperties.name: CryptoRandom_ReadWordBlocking

additionalProperties.comment: Native thunk to the NUL-terminated byte-string comparator; zero means equal.
additionalProperties.name: String_CompareCString

additionalProperties.comment: Compares NUL-terminated byte strings lexicographically as unsigned bytes; returns -1, 0 or 1.
additionalProperties.name: String_CompareCStringImpl

additionalProperties.comment: Startup hardware gate: reads imported HwVr and requires Classic revision >= 0x0300. Failure writes the softupdt warm-boot tag then resets the SoC. Success writes diskmode and continues initialization. Entered via IRAM thunk 0x220036c8.
additionalProperties.name: InitializeHardwareCheckedStartup

additionalProperties.comment: Constructs and registers the Hold switch debounce task object, enters the native task wait, then destroys the task object on return.
additionalProperties.name: HoldSwitch_RunTask

additionalProperties.comment: Walks the format string and ARM variadic argument words, emitting text through semihosting. Supports decimal, unsigned, hex, character, string and percent conversions with limited width handling. Literal spans are temporarily NUL-terminated by Semihost_WriteSpan, so format must be writable.
additionalProperties.name: Semihost_DebugVPrintf

additionalProperties.comment: Null returns -50; an already-set byte 0 returns 0. Otherwise checks embedded path+4 using storage mode +0xc: an existing path returns 0xffff5b81; an absent path sets byte 0 and returns 0xffff5b80. This is a state/status query, not a simple exists boolean.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_CheckStoragePathState

additionalProperties.comment: Checks buffered length <0x1000 and internal digest pointer, processes pending data without final padding, then exports the 64-byte partial block, counters and five byte-reversed chaining words. Clears workspace, releases backing and frees wrapper on success. Returns status; caller must clear its backend reference.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_SHA1ExportAndReleaseBackend
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_SHA1ExportAndReleaseBackend(OSOS_CryptoAlignedBuffer * backend, byte * partial_block, uint * bytes_low, uint * bytes_high, uint * state_words)

additionalProperties.comment: Decrements the shared control-block count. The last reference deletes the model through vtable +0x1c, releases its optional lock and frees the block. Clears the reference.
additionalProperties.name: LibraryModelRef_Release

additionalProperties.comment: Initializes a shared model reference. A nonnull model gets a 12-byte control block with count 1; synchronized creates an additional lock. The last reference deletes the model through vtable +0x1c.
additionalProperties.name: LibraryModelRef_Init
additionalProperties.value: void * __stdcall LibraryModelRef_Init(void * reference, void * model, int synchronized)

additionalProperties.comment: Releases the destination and copies the source control block with a retained count; self-assignment is unchanged. Returns destination.
additionalProperties.name: LibraryModelRef_Assign

additionalProperties.comment: Activates the base controller, resolves selection and adds the UI observer. Uses slot +0x124 to present the requested layout at +0xe0. Screen definition is at +0xb0.
additionalProperties.name: ResourceScreen_Activate

additionalProperties.comment: Removes the UI observer, deactivates the base controller and restores transition state from +0xe6 when leaving. Returns the base deactivate result.
additionalProperties.name: ResourceScreen_Deactivate

additionalProperties.comment: Removes the UI observer, deactivates the Brightness controller and restores saved transition state when leaving. Returns the underlying deactivate result.
additionalProperties.name: BrightnessScreen_Deactivate

additionalProperties.comment: Allocates or reuses a 0x28-byte event-map tree node. Pool growth starts at 32 nodes (0x500 bytes) plus a 12-byte chunk record, then grows by at least 32 nodes.
additionalProperties.name: UIEventMap_AllocateNode

additionalProperties.comment: Copies a key/binding pair into a new map node, sharing native string storage where permitted. Reserves max(32, action_count) 16-byte action slots even for an empty action vector.
additionalProperties.name: UIEventMap_CloneNode

additionalProperties.comment: Clears destination entries and recursively clones source tree nodes and bindings. Copies the element count and returns destination; does nothing on self-assignment.
additionalProperties.name: UIEventMap_Assign
BlockList_Erase
additionalProperties.value: void BlockList_Erase(void * * out_next, void * list, void * * node)

additionalProperties.comment: Returns the model pointer from a shared-reference control block, or null for an empty reference.
additionalProperties.name: LibraryModelRef_Get

additionalProperties.comment: Releases the reference-counted backing storage of the one-pointer C++ string. Leaves shared empty storage allocated.
additionalProperties.name: CppString_Destroy

additionalProperties.comment: Constructs the one-pointer C++ string from null-terminated text, copying nonempty text into owned storage. Returns the string object.
additionalProperties.name: CppString_Init

additionalProperties.comment: Constructs an owned C++ string from length bytes, including embedded NULs. Returns string.
additionalProperties.name: CppString_InitBytes
additionalProperties.value: void * __stdcall CppString_InitBytes(void * string, void * data, uint32_t bytes, void * allocator)

additionalProperties.comment: Looks up a native string key and inserts a default handled binding if absent. Returns the binding at node+0x14. Even existing-key lookup creates and destroys a temporary binding copy with 512-byte action capacity.
additionalProperties.name: UIEventMap_GetOrInsert

additionalProperties.comment: Finds or inserts a C++ string key in the resource-name map and returns its numeric ID slot.
additionalProperties.name: ResourceNames_FindOrInsertSlot

additionalProperties.comment: Finds or inserts a key/null-pointer pair and returns the address of its pointer value. Used by the controller layout cache.
additionalProperties.name: UIntPointerMap_GetOrInsert

additionalProperties.comment: Appends a copied 24-byte album row to a begin/end/capacity vector. Grows native storage when full and frees the previous allocation.

additionalProperties.comment: Copies IRAM, DRAM code and initialized data to their runtime addresses using the relocation delta in r0. Clears IRAM BSS and branches to the relocated IRAM entry.
additionalProperties.name: Startup_CopyImageToRuntimeRegions

additionalProperties.comment: Zeroes IRAM BSS at 0x2200af98 (0x57dc bytes) and DRAM BSS at 0x08a18d64 (0x12244c bytes). The intermediate clear length is zero.
additionalProperties.name: retailos_zero_runtime_bss

additionalProperties.comment:
Transferred from 2.0.4; absolute addresses below refer to that version.
Runs at IRAM 220071b0. r0=output queue, r1=position. Stores position at +0x13c and all 32 slots +0x34..+0xb0. Common reset reached from queue rebuild 220072cc, metadata clear 22007294, and underrun recovery 22007260. Called around decoder repositioning in 220054a8 via those reset paths. Synthesized-audio history must be invalidated when these queue positions reset.
additionalProperties.name: Audio_ResetOutputQueuePositions_IRAM_220071b0

additionalProperties.comment: Fills an audio output buffer. When exposure counting is enabled, output route is headphones (0), and volume exceeds the configured threshold, accumulates rendered frames / sample rate as float seconds. At the configured limit (default 72000 seconds), clears the counter and invokes the registered callback.
additionalProperties.name: Audio_FillOutputBuffer
